name: Part Of Me Loves You
source:
Zuzka's life is crumbling around them. They wake up with bruises they can't explain, and they are barely able to keep it together anymore. Just what lies in wait for them?

[From [url=https://fisheranimal.itch.io/part-of-me-loves-you]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
祖兹卡的生活在他们周围摇摇欲坠。他们醒来时浑身是无法解释的瘀伤，而且几乎无法再保持镇静。等待他们的到底是什么？

[来自[url=https://fisheranimal.itch.io/part-of-me-loves-you]itch.io[/url]]
